title: Apply and revert layouts without replacing Content
body:
Integrate validated arrangements with the active Project Window manager through deferred mutations. Move existing Content objects and implement one-level structural Revert with revision invalidation.
Spec: docs/superpowers/specs/2026-10-16-project-layouts-design.md
Blocked by: cizr5k - Persist project-owned saved layout libraries
Dispatch prerequisite: the spec must be committed and available in the worker checkout. This plan only creates Backlog cards; do not start later waves early.
Done when:
- Apply preserves Session instances/processes, grids/scrollback, Member ids, viewer targets/view state, and title/agent-state ownership.
- Exact matching, reconciliation, focus, child zoom, minimized restore, floating bounds, Modified tracking, and workspace dirtiness follow the spec.
- Other Projects and desktop geometry remain untouched. Invalid/stale transitions leave the current arrangement intact.
- Revert restores geometry/selection without rewinding Content; structural edits invalidate it. Never use cold restore for live Apply.
- Prove preservation through manager tests and supported Inspection where applicable. Update subsystem documentation.
Gate: Follow AGENTS.md and the build/validation/change-control references. Run cargo check --target-dir target/agent and cargo test --target-dir target/agent, plus focused behavior tests. GUI claims require inspected screenshots; process preservation requires manager/Inspection evidence.
